items.title: Jerry Coker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 18, 2023
items.q: INTERVIEWER mentions John Coltrane record; INTERVIEWEE responds 'Oh that’s too bad' regarding the interviewer's father's reaction, but provides no personal connection or interaction with Coltrane himself.

ctx.x: They reacted to it very much the same way we did. At first it was a little too much, you wondered what he was doing and that sort of thing. But over time they got used to that and so I couldn’t surprise them anymore. If I played something from somebody more remote, like Lee Konitz or someone, they still had the ability to shift into that gear to hear what he was doing. So it was — it was totally open with how we talked about jazz. We didn’t have to atone for any shortcomings by the other person.

That’s really fortunate for you. I know my father would come up to my room when I was playing the latest John Coltrane record and he would just open the door like with this puzzled look on his face. He did not enjoy it.
